event.summary: Lightning-caused fire in a clean room at Philips' Albuquerque chip fab; brief fire but smoke and water contaminated stock and the clean room.

known_at_decision.signal: delayed shipments noticed within days by the buyer's monitoring

options_considered: escalate to senior management and attack on all fronts: claim capacity at other Philips plants, redesign, new suppliers
human_choice: escalate to senior management and attack on all fronts: claim capacity at other Philips plants, redesign, new suppliers
outcome: Production largely protected; Nokia secured most of the available spare capacity.
sources: Latour, A. (2001) Wall Street Journal, 'Trial by fire'

event.summary: Same fire as above, seen from a buyer single-sourced at the plant.

options_considered: escalate to senior management and attack on all fronts: claim capacity at other Philips plants, redesign, new suppliers
outcome: Lost months of component supply; reported losses around USD 400M; exited handset manufacturing into Sony Ericsson (2001). Negative example.

event.summary: Fire at Aisin Seiki's Kariya plant, the sole source of P-valves for Toyota; Toyota assembly halted.

alternatives: no qualified alternative; keiretsu suppliers with machining capacity but no drawings

options_considered: network recovery: distribute drawings to many suppliers who improvise production
human_choice: network recovery: distribute drawings to many suppliers who improvise production
outcome: Around 200 firms helped; valve production restored within days and Toyota assembly restarted after roughly a week.
sources: Nishiguchi, T. & Beaudet, A. (1998) 'The Toyota Group and the Aisin Fire', Sloan Management Review

event.summary: Tohoku earthquake damaged Renesas' Naka fab, a major source of automotive microcontrollers.

options_considered: send engineers to accelerate Renesas recovery
cut production and allocate chips by model
human_choice: send engineers to accelerate Renesas recovery
outcome: Hundreds to thousands of outside workers helped; Naka resumed production around June 2011, earlier than first projected. Auto output still fell for months.

event.summary: Container ship Ever Given grounded in the Suez Canal, blocking it.

known_at_decision.expected_duration: unknown, estimates from days to weeks
known_at_decision.reroute_penalty: Cape of Good Hope adds roughly 1-2 weeks and fuel

options_considered: wait at anchor for the canal to reopen
reroute via the Cape of Good Hope
human_choice: wait at anchor for the canal to reopen
outcome: Canal reopened after about six days; most waiting vessels lost less time than a Cape reroute; a minority rerouted.

event.summary: Attacks on merchant ships in the Red Sea; no end date in sight.

options_considered: pause and reroute via the Cape of Good Hope
human_choice: pause and reroute via the Cape of Good Hope
outcome: Transits stayed suppressed for many months; rerouting avoided losses; shippers who booked capacity early fared better as rates rose.

event.summary: Francis Scott Key Bridge collapsed after a ship strike, closing the Port of Baltimore's main channel.

alternatives: other East Coast ports already in carriers' networks

options_considered: divert to Norfolk, New York/New Jersey and other ports
human_choice: divert to Norfolk, New York/New Jersey and other ports
outcome: Diversions absorbed most volume; the full channel reopened about two months later.

event.summary: Fire destroyed Ocado's automated Andover customer fulfilment centre.

alternatives: other fulfilment centres with spare capacity

options_considered: shift orders to other fulfilment centres and cap new orders in affected area
human_choice: shift orders to other fulfilment centres and cap new orders in affected area
outcome: Service continued at reduced capacity; site rebuilt later.

event.summary: Floods in Thailand inundated industrial estates producing a large share of the world's hard disk drives and components.

options_considered: lock in allocation and long-term contracts immediately
human_choice: lock in allocation and long-term contracts immediately
outcome: HDD prices rose sharply for months; buyers with secured allocation shipped, others cut output.
